title: A/R Summary: the Location header sorts A to Z, then Z to A
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Have three customers with open invoices on today's date: customer A only at location B, customer B at both locations and customer C only at location A. Both location names come after the word "Multiple" in A to Z order.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Location" header.
  2. Click the "Location" header again.
  3. Click the "Location" header a third time.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list sorts by Location, A to Z, comparing the words as they read: customer B ("Multiple"), then customer C (location A), then customer A (location B).

Step 2:

  • Z to A: customer A, customer C, customer B.

Step 3:

  • The same as step 1, A to Z again.
  • There is no unsorted state.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S2-R1, A/R Summary and A/P Summary columns: “A/R Summary and A/P Summary: the name column, Location (when shown), Current, 1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, 91 And Over, Total.”
  • S2-R1: “Every column on all six reports sorts when its header is clicked, except A/P Unpaid Invoices' Vendor Name column (S2-N1). The columns are:”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
  • S6-R5: “The column sorts A to Z on its first click; "Multiple" sorts as text.”
  • S6-R4: “On A/R Summary and A/P Summary a row shows the location's name when all of that customer's or vendor's open documents at the chosen locations are at one location, otherwise "Multiple".”
